about_short_description.short_description: Lomina.ai solves the problem of creating and selling personalized merchandise for micro-influencers.

product.name: AI Tech Platform
product.description: A platform that enables micro-influencers to design, produce, and sell personalized merchandise, transforming their influence into tangible products.

product.name: Collaborative Platform
product.description: A service for investors, suppliers, and designers to partner with Lomina.ai, focusing on shared success and mutual growth in influencer merchandising.

product.name: Full-Service Operations
product.description: A comprehensive service managing the entire process from design to logistics, ensuring streamlined operations for merchandise creation.

product.name: Data-Driven Insights
product.description: Analytics and insights service to help influencers and partners make informed decisions and optimize their merchandising strategies.
